## Quick Start / 快速开始

Run these commands to get started. No setup required.

开箱即用，运行以下命令即可。

```bash
# Network interfaces / 网络接口
ip -br addr 2>/dev/null || ifconfig 2>/dev/null | head -10

# Connection summary / 连接概况
ss -tan 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn

# DNS resolution test / DNS 解析测试
host google.com 2>/dev/null || nslookup google.com 2>/dev/null | head -6
```
